Changes.note: Appointing makes the person a Medaris nazım and gives them the platform permissions you chose; they see only those sections in Nizam. The post and the permissions end together; with no end they last until you change them. Permissions left over from a post the person lost are taken back with the appointment. “Edit permissions” changes the permissions to what you save. “Dismiss” takes back the post and the platform permissions; what they gave others you take over or drop, and what they gave themselves is taken back. Every step is written to the audit log. A dismissal cannot be undone: dropped permissions must be given again.
